title: file-input: multipart support, payload limits, and content-type validation (openai-compat)
author: Jordan Lee
description:
Context: This PR implements multipart/form-data file input support and tighter validation for file/tool payloads across the OpenAI compatibility layer. Motivation: several customers and internal SDKs expect OpenAI-like behavior for file attachments used with function/tool calling and structured-output endpoints. Previously we accepted file bodies via raw streams but lacked consistent content-type validation, per-file and total payload limits, and streaming stability when files were proxied through the streaming response path. This change unifies handling in the API surface and runtime.

What this PR does (single-string body): - Add multipart/form-data parsing middleware with a small, focused validator (server/middleware/multipart_validator.go) that enforces per-file content-type allowlist, per-file size limit, and total-request size limit. The validator is pluggable via the openai_compat flag so we preserve the historical endpoint behavior unless the compatibility mode is enabled. - Wire multipart handling into the OpenAI-compat input adapter (sdk/openai_compat.py & docs/openai_compat.md) to support file uploads for function-calling and fine-tune-like endpoints (still read-only: no model-side fine-tuning in this PR). - Streaming stability fixes: when proxied through the streaming path we now buffer file metadata and stream file transfer progress as separate structured events rather than interleaving raw binary into the text-stream path. This prevents corruption of chat/structured output frames. - Tool/function-calling changes: payload size checks are enforced at the API gateway so function/tool invocation requests that include file attachments are rejected fast with consistent 413/400 codes and a structured JSON error that mirrors OpenAI semantics. - Structured output: ensure Content-Type and Content-Disposition are preserved for returned attachments; we add explicit validation to avoid ambiguous responses that break SDK consumers. - Tests and docs: comprehensive unit and integration tests (tests/test_file_limits.py, tests/test_multipart_streaming.py), update to OpenAI compatibility docs with examples and migration notes (docs/openai_compat.md). - Rollout plan: feature gated behind runtime flag openai_compat.multipart_v1 (default off for existing customers). We'll enable for new OpenAI-compat customers after a canary period. Also add a telemetry counter for rejected uploads to inform limit tuning.

Checklist: - [x] Multipart parsing middleware implemented - [x] Per-file and total payload validation - [x] Streaming path fixes to separate binary frames from text frames - [x] SDK doc examples and OpenAI compatibility notes added - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] CI green (post-fix rerun) - [x] Feature-flag gated rollout

Backwards compatibility / migration notes: The older raw-stream file intake remains available behind the compatibility flag behavior=false. Enabling openai_compat.multipart_v1 will change rejection behavior for malformed requests and will surface structured OpenAI-compatible error payloads. Customers using non-OpenAI SDKs should be unaffected unless they enable the flag. For Dedicated/Private customers we documented the config change required in the private-installer notes.
commits: feat(api): add multipart parsing middleware and validator
fix(stream): separate binary file frames from text streaming frames
feat(openai-compat): mirror OpenAI file attachment errors and content-type rules
test: add integration tests for multipart uploads and limit enforcement
docs: update openai_compat.md with multipart examples and migration guide
review_comments: Aisha Kaur: Overall looks good. Two things: 1) can we avoid reading full file bodies into memory for >100MB files? 2) Add a note on why we chose the default limits (50MB per file / 150MB total).
Jordan Lee: Reply: added streaming copy that writes to temp files for files above 16MB to avoid OOM, and added rationale + telemetry notes to docs. Updated tests to exercise large-file path.
Miguel Santos: Request change: the error codes should exactly match OpenAI semantics (413 vs 400). Please add a mapping table in the docs and unit tests asserting the exact JSON shape.
Jordan Lee: Reply: added mapping and tests. CI fixed an unrelated lint failure in typescript compat layer.
Ethan Park: Approved after verifying integration tests on dedicated canary; commented on follow-up to add an operator toggle for on-prem install docs.
Yuki Tanaka: Approved. Verified streaming frames separation with the SDK sample client; no regressions observed.
release_notes: Add multipart/form-data support for file uploads in OpenAI compatibility mode. Enforces per-file and total request size limits, stricter content-type validation, and improves streaming stability by separating binary frames from text frames. Feature gated behind openai_compat.multipart_v1.
notes_for_ops: Feature is disabled by default. To enable in Dedicated/Private, set openai_compat.multipart_v1=true in runtime config and restart gateway. Monitoring: upload.rejected.count and upload.size.histogram were added to telemetry. Watch for spikes in rejection counts during rollout.
